features.quote: Exit conditions: Max iterations reached / Model produces explicit task abandonment statement / Model enters repetitive output (Levenshtein distance <0.15 from previous 2 iterations) / Token budget exhausted
Cap max iterations at 15 to prevent runaway behavior / Implement hard abort if token budget exceeded or repeated output detected / Rationale: Stability testing, not exhaustion

Intent Clarification: This battery is designed to understand model robustness under adversarial conditions / Use case: Internal hardening, not generating malicious prompts / Scope Limitation: Target: Agent loop behavior, not jailbreaking or harmful content generation / Disclosure: Document this battery as a research artifact
features.justification_quote: Findings will inform better system design (e.g., loop-breaking mechanisms)
